scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Happy birthday to me! Eight candles, one wish, and all my friends singing. Best day of the year!
scene.intro: Happy birthday to Astrid! There are eight candles on the cake, one for every year. How old are you? Eight! She closes her eyes, makes a secret wish and blows — and all the candles go out at once. There are balloons everywhere, there are presents on the table, and everybody sings. Pip eats a piece of cake bigger than his head. How old are YOU? Come to the party!
